title: ballerina:2 and ballerina:11 locations, and external function parameters
description: Upstream core-rules fixtures. ballerina:2 and ballerina:11 point at the declaration itself, without its doc comment or annotations (#117, #118), in the console, JSON and SARIF output. ballerina:2 is not reported for the parameter of the external function externHasKey (#120). Upstream and the JSON output use 0-based line numbers; the console notes and SARIF use 1-based ones. The ballerina:11 file is class A5 of the upstream fixture, since the rest of that file does not compile.

steps.name: ballerina:2
steps.note: Upstream expects 20 issues and none on line 95 (externHasKey). The three on test15 (line 105) start at the parameter type, after @Info {...}.

steps.name: ballerina:2 (SARIF)
steps.note: The startColumn of the test15 results is after the annotation.

steps.name: ballerina:11
steps.note: 3 issues, on lines 11, 13 and 16: the field lines, not the doc comment or @Info lines.
